reviewer_statement: Author-side full source report-string semantic review against published eyetrajectoriespy==1.2.0 at c1cd95ad718327550f7e55393ff38582872f7a94. FOS band minimum was relaxed for source reporter semantics; conformal source record component metadata and covariance clause restored. 32 complete typed Python 1.2 exact-source string comparisons and native malformed-record boundaries are committed. CI has not yet demonstrated these comparisons pass; this does not qualify full estimation or independent certification.
native_language_semantic_policy: Python frozen result dataclasses and identity-matched band are represented by checked native R scientific list/S3 records; source report strings retain full order, population-level inference, exact band clauses, component count and conformal covariance details. No reticulate in native implementation; Python runtime instance identity and exceptions remain language-specific.

case_evidence.description: Published frozen Python src/eyetrajectoriespy/reporting.py::function_on_scalar_reporting_text type and keyword contract. Native R supports source-equivalent semantic records, not Python runtime object identity.

FOS curve, participant and Unicode source-model variants with and without 1- and 100-replicate bands; conformal reconstruction RMSE and empirical/robust Mahalanobis covariance variants, 0/1/3/6/12 decimal precision and legacy missing-metadata rejection.

32 complete proposed typed Python 1.2 source-report exact-string comparisons (12 FOS + 20 conformal), including count and percentage formatting, conservatively tied flags, minimum attainable marginal p-values, ordered source narrative and covariance method annotations.

Native source-semantic validation rejects missing FOS identity-aligned band reference, zero bootstrap draws, source conformal flag/target length mismatch, invalid alpha, invalid source component metadata and decimal limits; Python TypeError class identity and arbitrary precision are distinct.
Exactly one full source manuscript-oriented character scalar per input; no plots or inferred estimator selection. Native report text follows published Python 1.2 fixed clauses and metadata order.

Native FOS regression reporting retains complete source OLS/HC1 model statement, curve vs participant inference unit policy and identity-associated wild-bootstrap band narratives; Python permits one or more typed bootstrap draws in the reporter, unlike the estimator minimum.

independent_review_status: Provisional developer source contract reviewed; exact-head Python 1.2 and three-OS CI pending; zero independent certifications.
language_specific_limits: Native checked R result lists/S3 classes do not assert Python dataclass instance identity and class-specific exceptions
FOS reporting text does not certify the underlying OLS/HC1 numerical estimator or bootstrap random draw backend
Conformal source-semantic report supports 0–12 decimal places natively and does not certify fitting or calibration randomness
Legacy native conformal screen lacks source FPCA component provenance, which must be explicitly supplied; new source-style records carry it intrinsically
